tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
MikroTik CRS317-1G-16S+RM – High-Performance 10G Fiber Switch

Powerful 16-Port 10G SFP+ Cloud Router Switch for Enterprise & ISP Networks

The MikroTik CRS317-1G-16S+RM is a high-performance, rackmountable 10G fiber switch, designed for enterprise, data centers, and ISPs that require ultra-fast and reliable networking. Featuring 16 x SFP+ ports, this powerful Layer 3 switch delivers blazing-fast 10G fiber connectivity, ensuring seamless data transfer, low latency, and enhanced network performance.


Equipped with dual boot support for RouterOS L6 and SwitchOS, the CRS317 offers flexibility to function as a powerful switch or an advanced routing device.


Key Features 

  • Ultra-Fast 10G Connectivity – 16 x SFP+ ports for high-speed fiber networking.
  • Reliable Backup Ethernet – 1 x Gigabit LAN port for additional network connectivity.
  • Dual Boot System – Choose between RouterOS L6 or SwitchOS based on network needs.
  • High-Performance Processing – 800MHz CPU & 1GB RAM for superior data handling.
  • Silent & Efficient Cooling – Fanless passive cooling ensures zero noise operation.
  • Rackmount-Ready Design – 1U metal enclosure for seamless integration into network racks.
  • Redundant Power Supply – Dual PSU for enhanced reliability and uptime.
  • Enterprise-Grade Build Quality – Made by MikroTik, Latvia for long-term performance.
  • 12-Month Limited Warranty – Reliable after-sales support and service.


Technical Specifications

  • Brand: MikroTik
  • Model: CRS317-1G-16S+RM
  • CPU: 800MHz
  • RAM: 1GB DDR3
  • SFP+ Ports: 16 x 10G SFP+ cages
  • Ethernet Ports: 1 x Gigabit LAN
  • Operating System: RouterOS L6 / SwitchOS (dual boot)
  • Switching Capacity: 320 Gbps
  • Forwarding Rate: 238 Mpps
  • Cooling: Fanless passive cooling system
  • Form Factor: 1U rackmount metal case
  • Power Supply: Dual redundant PSU
  • Manufacturing Origin: Made in Latvia
  • Warranty: 12-Month Limited Warranty

Ideal Applications

  • Data Centers & Enterprises – Scalable 10G fiber backbone for high-performance networking.
  • ISPs & Service Providers – Seamless fiber network expansion with superior reliability.
  • High-Performance Computing – Supports high-speed data transfer & low-latency operations.
  • Office & Silent Environments – Passive cooling ensures zero noise operation.


Why Choose MikroTik CRS317-1G-16S+RM?

  • Affordable High-Performance 10G Switching – Cost-effective and enterprise-grade.
  • Scalable & Reliable – Ideal for growing networks requiring high-speed connectivity.
  • Energy-Efficient & Silent – No fans, passive cooling, and reduced power consumption.
  • Redundant Power for Maximum Uptime – Dual PSU ensures continuous operation.
